thread:
maria: heads-up — during an AWQ INT8 bake I started seeing malformed JSON in funcall outputs, esp. when prompt chains hit >1k tokens
aj: ack, can you paste an example?
maria: sure, minimal repro from last run:
```
{"tool": "calendar.create", "args": {"title": "Q2 planning\n", "time": "2024-06-12T15:00:00Z"},}
```
kevin: lol trailing comma and unescaped newline in title — that's nasty
maria: right. looks like the model emits an extra comma sometimes or drops escapes under AWQ quantization; GPTQ/FP8 runs didn't show same rate
bench-bot: AWQ-int8 run 1719543000 summary: total 2,400 calls across eval set, invalid-json 112 (4.67%), incorrect-field-types 34 (1.42%)
bench-bot: GPTQ-int8 run 1719543050 summary: total 2,400 calls, invalid-json 9 (0.37%)
aj: big delta. can you share the prompt+config? flags used?
maria: running: `./run_eval --model redwood-awq-3b --quant awq --batch 8 --seed 42 --enable-funcall` — I switched only quant backend, kept same prompts & temp=0.2
olga: did you try stricter decode params (top_p, temperature) or force json schema sampling?
maria: lowered temp to 0.0 for one run, invalid-json dropped to 2.1% but still nonzero
kevin: could be tokenization/byte-level escape differences introduced by AWQ kernels. Maybe certain byte sequences get mapped to weird tokens and the model learns to emit unescaped newlines
aj: let's run a quick token-level diff on examples where AWQ fails and GPTQ passes; identify the first differing token in generation
maria: started that: looks like differences at tokens around the closing brace or comma insertion point
bench-bot: attached small artifact: s3://redwood-evals/awq-json-bad-samples/1719543.tar.gz (contains 112 bad outputs, diffs, seeds)
kevin: thanks. I'll run a small bisect across quant steps — try AWQ with per-layer fallback to fp16 for last n layers to see if error correlates with top layers
aj: also log the kv-cache lengths and whether kv-cache reuse/caching triggers altered output. we saw identical prompts but cached prefixes can change distribution
maria: created ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/3482 — title: "AWQ int8: funcall JSON emission errors on long chains" (added repro + artifact link)
olga: while we debug, can we add a defensive parse step in the funcall postprocessor? i.e., attempt to auto-fix common failures (strip trailing commas, escape newlines) then validate against schema; fallback to model re-gen if not fixable\aj: good idea. two quick options: 1) cheap sanitizer + schema check; 2) on-failure re-roll with higher-precision model (or same model with temp=0.0 and forcing single-shot)\e: (typo)
kevin: for perf-sensitive paths, maybe only apply sanitizer on Dedicated/private customers where we control model profiles; for hosted fast path we might prefer re-gen with fp16 fallback to avoid hallucinated tool args
maria: added PR draft: `fix/funcall-json-sanitizer` — will include sanitizer heuristics and a metrics counter for auto-fixed vs regen vs hard-fail
bench-bot: quick canary: deployed sanitizer to staging route `funcall-v2` — 50 requests so far, 3 auto-fixed, 0 regens required, no latencysig spike
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: deploy id d-20240428-12: staging.funcall-v2
aj: Great. For the investigation next: kevin — run per-layer quant sensitivity and report which layers cause the comma issue; maria — expand failing set to include toolargs with nested json and escaped unicode; olga — spec sanitizer heuristics and edge cases\kevin: on it, starting long-run now, ETA ~3h\maria: thanks. pulling a quick dashboard: we should track invalid-json by model variant, quant backend, prompt-length bucket, and cache-hit flag\olga: I'll add metrics in MetricsQL and dashboard tile for morning standup\maria: any objections to making sanitizer default on hosted for now?\aj: i'd prefer we keep it opt-in until we get more data — sanitizer can mask root cause. enable it for staging + dedicated customers by default\maria: fair. enabling for staging + dedicated only. leaving ticket with action items: bisect quant layers (kevin), artifact analysis (aj), sanitizer PR (maria) — referenced issue #3482\kevin: if bisect shows top-2 layers are culprit we can try partial-fp16 trick as temporary rollout\maria: ok cool. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
